14 September 1949
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Control of Radio Communications.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum for the Japanese Government, file AG 676.3 (14 Jul 47)CCS, SCAPIN 1744, dated 14 July 1947, subject: Control of Radio Communications, as amended.
2. Inclosures 1 and 2 of this memorandum are the bimonthly lists of amendments, including all additions, deletions, and changes to Inclosures 1 and 2 of SCAPIN 1744/17, prepared and submitted in accordance with paragraphs 12 and 13 of reference 1.
3. This memorandum reaffirms the authorization of all amendments authorized by direct communication between Civil Communications Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, and the Ministry of Telecommunications during July and August 1949.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
